name: inline-code
title: Inline code
description: Code inside a sentence: a quiet mono chip that wraps cleanly, with an optional click to copy.
docs: It inherits the surrounding font size. copyable turns the chip into a Copy button; pass value when the children are not plain text. Your other props land on the code, or on the button when it is copyable. Plain inline code is a Server Component; only the copyable part is a client module.
